title: Actor-Predictor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning with Formal Specification Objectives
title_zh: 面向形式规约目标的强化学习：Actor-Predictor 架构
abstract_en: One fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is enforcing temporal safety constraints, such as satisfying formal specifications. Existing methods often transform logic formulas into automata for state augmentation and reward shaping. However, this approach assumes that automaton construction is both feasible and tractable, which limits its applicability to small specifications and linear temporal logic (LTL). This paper proposes Actor-Predictor, a framework that learns a surrogate representation of logic progress without explicitly constructing an automaton. The predictor continuously estimates whether a partial trajectory will satisfy the formal specification in a later step, and its learned features are provided as auxiliary inputs to the actor, which is then optimized using GRPO and RWR. We show theoretically that, under sufficient predictive accuracy, the learned representation is equivalent to the automaton state. Experiments on grid world and robotic tasks in Isaac Lab demonstrate that Actor-Predictor outperforms automaton-based baselines on LTL-constrained tasks. It also performs well on non-regular formal specifications, such as $(a^n b^n)$, for which finite-automaton-based approaches are not applicable.
abstract_zh: 在强化学习（RL）中，如何让策略在整条轨迹上满足时序安全约束，是一个基本挑战。现有方法通常将逻辑公式转换为自动机，用于扩充状态和塑造奖励，但这依赖于自动机既能构造、构造成本又可接受，因此往往局限于规模较小的线性时序逻辑（LTL）规约。本文提出 Actor-Predictor，无需显式构造自动机，而是学习表征轨迹满足规约的进展。预测器持续估计当前的部分轨迹在后续能否满足规约，并将学到的特征作为策略网络的辅助输入；策略网络使用 GRPO 和 RWR 优化。理论分析表明，当预测足够准确时，学习到的表示与自动机状态等价。在网格世界（Grid World）和 Isaac Lab 机器人任务中，Actor-Predictor 在 LTL 约束任务上优于基于自动机的基线，在有限自动机无法表达的非正则规约（如 aⁿbⁿ）上也表现良好。
key_points_zh: 以预测器学习规约满足进度，避免把逻辑公式显式编译成自动机。
预测器根据部分轨迹估计后续能否满足规约，其学习特征用于辅助策略决策；策略通过 GRPO 和 RWR 优化。
理论上，当预测足够准确时，学习到的表示与自动机状态等价。
在网格世界和 Isaac Lab 的 LTL 约束任务中优于基于自动机的基线，并能处理 aⁿbⁿ 等非正则规约。
